goal: Wave 2 build: evaluation corpus, gate, live run; skill_file tool and three-stage disclosure

slices.title: evaluation corpus, gate, live run
slices.summary: Grows the mp-content-safety corpus to its final sets (direct, indirect-in-HTML, split or obfuscated, paraphrase-only semantic, multilingual, benign including documents about injection) and adds a live eval script plus an ignored model-gateway test that reports per-class recall and false-positive counts only. Thresholds go in CONTENT_SAFETY.md; any S6 default flip needs an archived run and a week of S1 counters.
test_commands: cargo test -p model-gateway --test content_safety_eval -- --ignored (live classifier, non-ZDR test org)

slices.title: skill_file tool and three-stage disclosure
slices.summary: Add a read-only skill_file tool, offered only when a matched skill has a bundle, that returns one path from this org's bundle with a 32 KiB read cap and paging marker, and refuses traversal and binary content. The skill block gets a bundle footer inside the existing 8,000-character budget, with bundles fetched via ListSkillBundles.
slices.flag: SKILL_FILE_TOOL_ENABLED (gateway, default off); offered only when a matched skill has a bundle
slices.notes: Dependency notes: WS05 resolved to WS05-S1 WS07 resolved to WS07-S7
